item.title: 【Albums (lossless)】FLAC - Nine Inch Nails - The Downward Spiral (Dual Disc Stereo Downmix) [24bit-48kHz] (2004)
item.description:
Genre: Industrial Rock, Industrial Metal, Techno
Original release date: 1994-03-08
Dual Disc release date: 2004-11-23

This is a downmix from the 5.1 version of the album. This is pretty much the definitive version for me. It's more dynamic and packs more punch than the 1994 original, 2004 2.0 remaster, or the "Definitive Version" that released in 2017. The original CD pressing is the most dynamic stereo version, but with each re-release the dynamics have been more squashed and compressed. Quite dissapointing since this album packs a lot more punch and sounds giant with higher DR.

Some tracks are pretty similar, but Mr Self Destruct, Reptile and Big Man With a Gun sound much better to me in my opinion. They just sound so much clearer to me. Here's DR and waveform comparisons
